python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
print('n files:', len(files))
data = {}
for f in files:
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    date_col = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[date_col] = pd.to_datetime(df[date_col])
    df = df.set_index(date_col).sort_index()
    close = df['close'] if 'close' in df.columns else df.iloc[:, 3]
    data[sym] = close.dropna()

px = pd.DataFrame(data).sort_index()
print('date range:', px.index.min(), '->', px.index.max())
print('shape:', px.shape)

# Use data through 2026-07-15 (visible)
px = px[px.index <= '2026-07-15']

rets = px.pct_change()
last = px.iloc[-1]
print('\n=== LEVELS & RECENT RETURNS (through %s) ===' % px.index[-1].date())
for sym in px.columns:
    s = px[sym]
    r1m = s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-22]-1 if len(s)>22 else np.nan
    r3m = s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-66]-1 if len(s)>66 else np.nan
    r6m = s.iloc[-1]/s.iloc[-132]-1 if len(s)>132 else np.nan
    # MA slopes
    ma20 = s.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = s.rolling(60).mean()
    slope20 = (ma20.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-6]-1) if len(s)>25 else np.nan
    ann_vol = rets[sym].iloc[-60:].std()*np.sqrt(252) if len(rets)>60 else np.nan
    print('%-10s last=%10.2f  1m=%+6.1f%%  3m=%+6.1f%%  6m=%+6.1f%%  ma20_6d_slope=%+.2f%%  ann_vol60=%5.1f%%' % (
        sym, s.iloc[-1], r1m*100, r3m*100, r6m*100, slope20*100, ann_vol*100))

# VIX
vix = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv')
vix.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in vix.columns]
vc = 'close' if 'close' in vix.columns else vix.columns[3]
vix['date'] = pd.to_datetime(vix[vix.columns[0]])
vix = vix.set_index('date').sort_index()
vixs = vix[vc].dropna()
vixs = vixs[vixs.index <= '2026-07-15']
print('\n=== VIX (observation) ===')
print('last:', round(vixs.iloc[-1],2), ' 1m ago:', round(vixs.iloc[-22],2), ' 3m ago:', round(vixs.iloc[-66],2) if len(vixs)>66 else 'NA')
print('60d mean:', round(vixs.iloc[-60:].mean(),2), ' 60d max:', round(vixs.iloc[-60:].max(),2))

# Cross-sectional dispersion & correlation
print('\n=== Cross-asset correlation (60d, avg pairwise) ===')
corr60 = rets.iloc[-60:].corr()
vals = corr60.values[np.triu_indices_from(corr60.values, k=1)]
print('avg pairwise corr (60d): %.3f' % np.nanmean(vals))
corr20 = rets.iloc[-20:].corr()
vals20 = corr20.values[np.triu_indices_from(corr20.values, k=1)]
print('avg pairwise corr (20d): %.3f' % np.nanmean(vals20))

# Dispersion: cross-sectional std of 1d returns
disp = rets.std(axis=1)
print('avg cross-sectional dispersion (20d): %.3f%%' % (disp.iloc[-20:].mean()*100))

# Trend breadth: fraction of assets above 60d MA
above = (px.iloc[-1] > px.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1]).mean()
print('fraction above 60d MA: %.2f' % above)
EOF

python << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

px = {}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv')):
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    px[sym] = df['close']
P = pd.DataFrame(px).sort_index()
P = P[P.index <= '2026-07-15'].ffill()

rets = P.pct_change()
print('=== 15-NAME CROSS-ASSET REGIME (visible through 2026-07-15) ===')
for sym in P.columns:
    s = P[sym]
    r1m = s.iloc[-1]/s.loc[s.index[-22]]-1
    r3m = s.iloc[-1]/s.loc[s.index[-66]]-1
    r6m = s.iloc[-1]/s.loc[s.index[-132]]-1
    ma20 = s.rolling(20).mean(); ma60 = s.rolling(60).mean()
    slope20 = ma20.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-6]-1
    vol = rets[sym].iloc[-60:].std()*np.sqrt(252)
    dd = (s/s.cummax()-1).iloc[-1]
    print('%-10s last=%9.2f  1m=%+6.1f%% 3m=%+6.1f%% 6m=%+6.1f%% ma20slope=%+5.2f%% vol60=%5.1f%% dd_from_peak=%6.1f%%' % (
        sym, s.iloc[-1], r1m*100, r3m*100, r6m*100, slope20*100, vol*100, dd*100))

print('\nBreadth above 60d MA: %.2f' % (P.iloc[-1] > P.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1]).mean())
print('Breadth above 20d MA: %.2f' % (P.iloc[-1] > P.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1]).mean())

c = rets.iloc[-60:].corr().values
print('avg pairwise corr 60d: %.3f' % np.nanmean(c[np.triu_indices_from(c,1)]))
c20 = rets.iloc[-20:].corr().values
print('avg pairwise corr 20d: %.3f' % np.nanmean(c20[np.triu_indices_from(c20,1)]))
print('avg cross-sectional daily dispersion 20d: %.3f%%' % (rets.iloc[-20:].std(axis=1).mean()*100))

# VIX
v = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv'); v.columns=[c.strip().lower() for c in v.columns]
v['date']=pd.to_datetime(v['date']); v=v.set_index('date').sort_index()['close'].dropna()
v = v[v.index <= '2026-07-15']
print('\nVIX last=%.1f 60d mean=%.1f pctile_vs_2020_hist=%.0f%%' % (v.iloc[-1], v.iloc[-60:].mean(), (v < v.iloc[-1]).mean()*100))

# recent 10d return pattern (reversal environment?)
r10 = rets.iloc[-10:].sum()
print('\n10d cumulative returns:')
for sym in r10.sort_values().index:
    print('  %-10s %+6.2f%%' % (sym, r10[sym]*100))
EOF

python << 'EOF'
import json, glob, os

# --- Load active library (canonical, non-timestamped top-level factor files) ---
factor_files = {}
for f in sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json')):
    if f.endswith('.bak'): continue
    base = os.path.basename(f)
    # skip timestamped duplicates: keep the canonical file (no '.T...' segment)
    if 'T' in base and any(ch.isdigit() for ch in base.split('.')[1] if ch.isdigit()):
        continue
    d = json.load(open(f))
    factor_files[d['factor_id']] = d

print('Canonical active factors:', len(factor_files))

# --- Quality & penalty ---
def q_of(fid):
    d = factor_files[fid]
    m = d['validation']['metrics']
    ic1 = m['ic1']; icir1 = m['icir1']
    return abs(ic1) * abs(icir1), ic1

rows = []
for fid, d in factor_files.items():
    m = d['validation']['metrics']
    ic1, icir1 = m['ic1'], m['icir1']
    q = abs(ic1)*abs(icir1)
    cov = m.get('coverage', 1.0)
    to = m.get('turnover_10d', 0.0)
    rows.append((fid, ic1, icir1, q, cov, to, d.get('tags', [])))

rows.sort(key=lambda r: -r[3])
print('\n%-42s %8s %8s %9s %6s %7s' % ('factor', 'ic1', 'icir1', 'q', 'cov', 'tov10'))
for r in rows:
    print('%-42s %8.4f %8.3f %9.6f %6.2f %7.2f' % (r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5]))

# --- Selection: dedupe exact twins, top-quality reversal family + orthogonal momentum contrarian ---
# cz_rev1 == rev_1d (rho=1.0, identical by-year IC) -> keep rev_1d (higher q)
selected_ids = [
    'miner2_20260715_nclv_1d',
    'miner2_20260715_rev_1d',
    'miner2_20260715_nclv_2d',
    'miner2_20260715_nclv_3d',
    'miner2_20260715_nbody_1d',
    'miner2_20260715_rev_2d',
    'miner2_20260716_mom_10d_skip5',  # orthogonal diversifier, direction -1 (contrarian)
]

# adjusted quality: sqrt(coverage) penalty + turnover penalty min(1, 0.5/turnover_10d)
adj = {}
for fid in selected_ids:
    q, _ = q_of(fid)
    m = factor_files[fid]['validation']['metrics']
    cov = m.get('coverage', 1.0)
    to = m.get('turnover_10d', 0.0)
    cov_p = cov ** 0.5
    to_p = min(1.0, 0.5 / to) if to > 0 else 1.0
    adj[fid] = q * cov_p * to_p

print('\nAdjusted quality:')
for fid in selected_ids:
    print('  %-42s q_adj=%.6f' % (fid, adj[fid]))

# floor for the orthogonal diversifier at 5% (diversification constraint), rest by quality tilt
MOM = 'miner2_20260716_mom_10d_skip5'
floor = 0.05
others = [fid for fid in selected_ids if fid != MOM]
s_other = sum(adj[fid] for fid in others)
weights = {fid: (1.0 - floor) * adj[fid] / s_other for fid in others}
weights[MOM] = floor

# direction: sign of IC (mom has negative IC -> direction -1)
directions = {}
for fid in selected_ids:
    _, ic1 = q_of(fid)
    directions[fid] = 1 if ic1 >= 0 else -1

print('\nFinal ensemble (sum=%.4f):' % sum(weights.values()))
ens = []
for fid in selected_ids:
    ens.append({'factor_id': fid, 'weight': round(weights[fid], 6), 'direction': directions[fid]})
    print('  %-42s w=%.6f dir=%+d' % (fid, weights[fid], directions[fid]))

out = {'schema_version': 1, 'selected_factors': ens, 'method': 'quality_ic_tilt'}
with open('factor_ensemble.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
print('\nWROTE factor_ensemble.json')
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
EOF

python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

# Load all 15 tradables from persistent stock_data
files = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px = {}
for s in files:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{s}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    dcol = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[dcol] = pd.to_datetime(df[dcol])
    df = df.sort_values(dcol).set_index(dcol)
    ccol = 'close' if 'close' in df.columns else df.columns[1]
    px[s] = df[ccol].astype(float)
PX = pd.DataFrame(px)
print("Date range:", PX.index.min(), "->", PX.index.max(), "| rows:", len(PX))
PX = PX.dropna(how='all')
last = PX.index[-1]
print("Last date:", last.date())

# Recent returns
ret = PX.pct_change()
for w in [1, 5, 10, 21, 63]:
    col = f'r{w}'
    PX[col] = PX[ccol if False else 'close'].pct_change(w) if False else ret.rolling(w).sum()
print("\n== Recent returns (last 10d, 21d, 63d) % ==")
r10 = ret.rolling(10).sum().iloc[-1]*100
r21 = ret.rolling(21).sum().iloc[-1]*100
r63 = ret.rolling(63).sum().iloc[-1]*100
for s in files:
    print(f"{s:8s} 10d:{r10[s]:+6.1f}%  21d:{r21[s]:+6.1f}%  63d:{r63[s]:+7.1f}%")

# MA breadth
ma20 = PX['close'].rolling(20).mean()
ma60 = PX['close'].rolling(60).mean()
above20 = (PX['close'].iloc[-1] > ma20.iloc[-1]).mean()
above60 = (PX['close'].iloc[-1] > ma60.iloc[-1]).mean()
print(f"\nBreadth: above 20d MA: {above20:.0%} | above 60d MA: {above60:.0%}")

# Cross-asset correlation (20d)
corr20 = ret.tail(20).corr()
print("Avg |pairwise corr| (20d):", np.abs(corr20.values[np.triu_indices(15,1)]).mean().round(3))
corr60 = ret.tail(60).corr()
print("Avg |pairwise corr| (60d):", np.abs(corr60.values[np.triu_indices(15,1)]).mean().round(3))

# Vol regime
vol20 = ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print("\n20d annualized vol by asset:")
for s in files:
    print(f"  {s:8s} {vol20[s]*100:5.1f}%")
print("Median 20d vol:", f"{vol20.median()*100:.1f}%")

# Drawdown from 252d high
dd = PX['close']/PX['close'].rolling(252).max() - 1
print("\nCurrent drawdown from 252d high (top/bottom):")
print(dd.iloc[-1].sort_values().round(4).to_string())

# Trend strength: 20d MA slope over last 10d (pct)
ma20_slope = (ma20.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-11] - 1)*100
print("\n20d MA slope over last 10d (%):")
print(ma20_slope.round(2).to_string())
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np

import json, glob, os, base64, gzip
import numpy as np

files = sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json'))
uniq = [f for f in files if '.bak' not in f and not any(t in os.path.basename(f) for t in ['20260810T','20260811T'])]

def load_signal(f):
    d = json.load(open(f))
    sa = d.get('signal_artifact', {})
    if isinstance(sa, str):
        return None, sa
    fmt = sa.get('format','')
    if 'gzip+base64' in fmt:
        raw = base64.b64decode(sa['data'])
        mat = np.frombuffer(gzip.decompress(raw), dtype=np.float32).reshape(sa['n_dates'], sa['n_symbols'])
        return mat, sa.get('date_start')
    return None, None

signals = {}
for f in uniq:
    fid = json.load(open(f))['factor_id']
    mat, ds = load_signal(f)
    if mat is not None:
        signals[fid] = mat
    else:
        print("NO SIGNAL ARTIFACT:", fid)

print("Loaded signals:", list(signals.keys()))
# check shapes
shapes = {k: v.shape for k,v in signals.items()}
print(shapes)
# align on common dates via NaN pattern - just compute pairwise corr on common non-nan rows
ids = list(signals.keys())
import itertools
print("\nPairwise Pearson correlations of raw signals (common non-NaN obs):")
for a,b in itertools.combinations(ids,2):
    A, B = signals[a], signals[b]
    n = min(A.shape[0], B.shape[0])
    A, B = A[:n], B[:n]
    mask = np.isfinite(A) & np.isfinite(B)
    if mask.sum() < 30:
        print(f"{a[:45]} vs {b[:45]}: insufficient")
        continue
    # vectorize across assets
    aa = A[mask]; bb = B[mask]
    cc = np.corrcoef(aa, bb)[0,1]
    if abs(cc) > 0.5:
        print(f"{a[:45]:45s} vs {b[:45]:45s}: r={cc:.3f}  (n={mask.sum()})")
EOF

import json, glob, os, base64, gzip, itertools
import numpy as np

files = sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json'))
uniq = [f for f in files if '.bak' not in f and not any(t in os.path.basename(f) for t in ['20260810T','20260811T'])]

def load_signal(f):
    d = json.load(open(f))
    sa = d.get('signal_artifact', {})
    if isinstance(sa, str):
        return None
    if 'gzip+base64' in sa.get('format',''):
        raw = base64.b64decode(sa['data_b64'])
        mat = np.frombuffer(gzip.decompress(raw), dtype=np.float32).reshape(sa['n_dates'], sa['n_symbols'])
        return mat
    return None

signals = {}
for f in uniq:
    fid = json.load(open(f))['factor_id']
    mat = load_signal(f)
    if mat is not None:
        signals[fid] = mat
    else:
        print("NO SIGNAL:", fid, f)

print("Loaded:", len(signals))
ids = list(signals.keys())
print("\nPairwise |r|>0.5 (raw signal correlation, common non-NaN obs):")
pairs = []
for a,b in itertools.combinations(ids,2):
    A, B = signals[a], signals[b]
    n = min(A.shape[0], B.shape[0])
    A, B = A[:n], B[:n]
    mask = np.isfinite(A) & np.isfinite(B)
    if mask.sum() < 30: continue
    r = np.corrcoef(A[mask], B[mask])[0,1]
    if abs(r) > 0.5:
        pairs.append((abs(r), a, b, r))
for ar,a,b,r in sorted(pairs, reverse=True):
    print(f"  {a[:42]:42s} vs {b[:42]:42s}: r={r:+.3f}")
print("\nMax abs corr per factor:")

        mask = np.isfinite(A)&np.isfinite(B)
        if mask.sum()<30: continue
        r = abs(np.corrcoef(A[mask],B[mask])[0,1])

    print(f"  {a[:42]:42s}: max|r|={best:.3f} vs {other[:30]}")

python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
data = {}
for f in files:
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= '2026-07-15'].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    data[sym] = df

print("Data ranges (through 2026-07-15):")
for sym, df in data.items():
    print(f"  {sym:10s}: {df['date'].iloc[0].date()} -> {df['date'].iloc[-1].date()}  rows={len(df)}")

# Recent 1y window for regime
end = pd.Timestamp('2026-07-15')
start = end - pd.Timedelta(days=400)
rets = {}
for sym, df in data.items():
    df = df[df['date'] >= start]
    px = df['close']
    rets[sym] = px.pct_change().dropna()

print("\n=== Regime metrics (last ~250 trading days) ===")
print(f"{'sym':10s} {'20d ret':>9s} {'60d ret':>9s} {'120d ret':>10s} {'250d ret':>10s} {'ann_vol20':>9s} {'ann_vol60':>9s}")
for sym, df in data.items():
    df = df[df['date'] >= start]
    px = df['close']
    r = px.pct_change().dropna()
    def ret(n):
        return (px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-1-n]-1)*100 if len(px)>n else np.nan
    vol20 = r.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
    vol60 = r.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)*100
    print(f"{sym:10s} {ret(20):9.2f} {ret(60):9.2f} {ret(120):10.2f} {ret(250):10.2f} {vol20:9.1f} {vol60:9.1f}")
EOF

import json, glob, os, base64, gzip
import numpy as np

files = sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json'))

    if '.bak' in f or '20260810T' in f:
        continue
    d = json.load(open(f))
    fid = d.get('factor_id', os.path.basename(f).replace('.json',''))

    # decode signal

            raw = base64.b64decode(sa['data_b64'])
            arr = np.frombuffer(gzip.decompress(raw), dtype=np.float32).reshape(sa['n_dates'], sa['n_symbols'])
            sig = arr
        except Exception as e:
            sig = None
    seen[fid] = dict(
        ic1=m.get('ic1'), icir1=m.get('icir1'), hit=m.get('hit1'),
        turn=m.get('turnover_10d'), ic5=m.get('ic5'), icir5=m.get('icir5'),
        y24=by.get('2024',{}).get('ic'), y24i=by.get('2024',{}).get('icir'),
        y25=by.get('2025',{}).get('ic'), y25i=by.get('2025',{}).get('icir'),
        y26=by.get('2026',{}).get('ic'), y26i=by.get('2026',{}).get('icir'),
        dirn=d.get('expected_direction', d.get('direction', 1)),
        sig=sig, tags=d.get('tags',[]),
        sel_ic=d.get('benchmark_admission',{}).get('selected_metrics',{}).get('ic'),
        sel_icir=d.get('benchmark_admission',{}).get('selected_metrics',{}).get('icir'),
        sel_q=d.get('benchmark_admission',{}).get('selected_metrics',{}).get('quality'),
    )

print(f"{'factor':<28} {'ic1':>6} {'icir1':>6} {'ic5':>6} {'icir5':>6} {'hit':>5} {'turn10':>6} {'y24ic':>6} {'y25ic':>6} {'y26ic':>6} {'dir':>3} {'sig':>3}")
names = []
for fid, v in sorted(seen.items()):
    print(f"{fid:<28} {v['ic1']:>6.4f} {v['icir1']:>6.3f} {v['ic5']:>6.4f} {v['icir5']:>6.3f} {v['hit']:>5.3f} {v['turn']:>6.3f} {v['y24']:>6.4f} {v['y25']:>6.4f} {v['y26']:>6.4f} {v['dirn']:>3} {('Y' if v['sig'] is not None else 'N'):>3}")
    names.append(fid)

# pairwise correlation on decoded signals (last 250 rows, cross-sectional)
import itertools
print("\n=== Pairwise |corr| >= 0.5 (last 500 rows) ===")
for a,b in itertools.combinations(names,2):

    if sa_ is None or sb_ is None: continue
    n = min(500, sa_.shape[0], sb_.shape[0])
    A, B = sa_[-n:], sb_[-n:]
    r = np.corrcoef(A.ravel(), B.ravel())[0,1]
    if abs(r) >= 0.5:
        print(f"{a} vs {b}: r={r:.3f}")

python - <<'EOF'
import json, glob, os, base64, gzip
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# Load close panel from persistent stock data
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
print("panel files:", len(files))
closes = {}
for f in files:
    sym = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] if 'date' in df.columns else df.iloc[:,0])
    df = df.set_index('date').sort_index()
    closes[sym] = df['close'] if 'close' in df.columns else df.iloc[:,1]
panel = pd.DataFrame(closes).sort_index()
print("panel shape:", panel.shape, panel.index.min(), panel.index.max())

# Load factor signals
def load_sig(path):
    d = json.load(open(path))
    fid = d.get('factor_id', os.path.basename(path).replace('.json',''))
    sa = d.get('signal_artifact',{}) or {}
    if isinstance(sa, dict) and str(sa.get('format','')).startswith('gzip'):
        raw = base64.b64decode(sa['data_b64'])
        sig = np.frombuffer(gzip.decompress(raw), dtype=np.float32).reshape(sa['n_dates'], sa['n_symbols'])
        dates = pd.date_range(sa['date_start'], sa['date_end'], freq='B')
        return fid, pd.DataFrame(sig, index=dates[:sig.shape[0]], columns=sa['symbols'])
    return fid, None

cands = ['factors/miner2_20260715_nclv_1d.json','factors/miner2_20260715_rev_1d.json',
         'factors/miner1_20260715_rev1_pk.json','factors/miner1_20260715_rev1_x_inveff.json']
sigs = {}
for p in cands:
    fid, s = load_sig(p)
    if s is not None: sigs[fid] = s
# mom from npy
d = json.load(open('factors/miner2_20260716_mom_10d_skip5.json'))
fid = d['factor_id']
sig = np.load('factors/miner2_20260716_mom_10d_skip5.npy')
# npy is full panel length; need its date axis -> use panel index
sigs[fid] = pd.DataFrame(sig[-panel.shape[0]:], index=panel.index, columns=panel.columns)

# Align all signals to panel index
ret1 = panel.pct_change().shift(-1)  # next-day return
def ic_window(sig_df, ret, window):
    idx = sig_df.index.intersection(ret.index)
    sig_df = sig_df.loc[idx]; ret = ret.loc[idx]
    ics = []
    for t in range(len(idx)):
        s = sig_df.iloc[t]; r = ret.iloc[t]
        m = s.notna() & r.notna()
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            ics.append(pd.Series(s[m]).rank().corr(pd.Series(r[m]).rank()))
    ics = pd.Series(ics)
    return ics

print("\n=== Recent rank-IC1 (mean over trailing window) ===")
print(f"{'factor':<30} {'60d':>7} {'120d':>7} {'250d':>7} {'all':>7}")
for fid, s in sigs.items():
    ics = ic_window(s, ret1, None)
    if ics is None or len(ics)==0: continue
    print(f"{fid:<30} {ics.tail(60).mean():>7.4f} {ics.tail(120).mean():>7.4f} {ics.tail(250).mean():>7.4f} {ics.mean():>7.4f}  (n={len(ics)})")
EOF

python - <<'EOF'
import json, glob, os, gzip, base64
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

files = sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json'))
files = [f for f in files if not f.endswith('.bak') and '.202' not in f.split('/')[-1] and 'evicted' not in f]

matrices = {}
for f in files:
    d = json.load(open(f))
    fid = d['factor_id']
    sa = d.get('signal_artifact', {})
    if not isinstance(sa, dict) or 'data' not in sa:
        print(fid, "NO signal data")
        continue
    raw = base64.b64decode(sa['data'])
    arr = np.frombuffer(gzip.decompress(raw), dtype=np.float32).reshape(sa['shape'])
    dates = pd.to_datetime(sa['dates'])
    syms = sa['symbols']
    matrices[fid] = pd.DataFrame(arr, index=dates, columns=syms)
    print(fid, arr.shape, dates[0].date(), dates[-1].date())

# common date range
common = None
for fid, m in matrices.items():
    common = m.index if common is None else common.intersection(m.index)
print("\ncommon dates:", len(common))

# pairwise correlation of factor signals (cross-sectional rank IC style: use per-date cs rank, then correlate the stacked panel)
# Use panel correlation of cs-ranks across common dates
stack = {}
for fid, m in matrices.items():
    m = m.loc[common]
    r = m.rank(axis=1)  # cross-sectional rank per date
    stack[fid] = r.values.flatten()

S = pd.DataFrame(stack)
corr = S.corr()
np.fill_diagonal(corr.values, np.nan)
print("\nPAIRWISE SIGNAL CORRELATION (cs-rank, common dates):")
print(corr.round(3).to_string())

# max abs corr per factor
print("\nMax |corr| with any other factor:")
mx = corr.abs().max(axis=1)
print(mx.sort_values(ascending=False).round(3).to_string())
EOF

import json, glob, os
files = sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json'))
files = [f for f in files if not f.endswith('.bak')]
seen = {}
for f in files:
    try:
        d = json.load(open(f))
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERR", f, e); continue
    fid = d.get('factor_id', os.path.basename(f))
    # dedupe by factor_id, keep most recent mtime
    m = os.path.getmtime(f)
    if fid not in seen or m > seen[fid][0]:
        seen[fid] = (m, f, d)
print("Unique factor_ids:", len(seen))
rows = []
for fid,(m,f,d) in seen.items():
    v = d.get('validation', {})
    met = v.get('metrics', {})
    ba = d.get('benchmark_admission', {})
    sm = ba.get('selected_metrics', {})
    tags = d.get('tags', [])
    rows.append((fid, met.get('ic1'), met.get('icir1'), met.get('hit1'), sm.get('ic'), sm.get('icir'), tags, f))
rows.sort(key=lambda r: -(abs(r[1] or 0)*abs(r[2] or 0)))
for r in rows:
    print(f"{r[0]:45s} ic1={r[1]:.4f} icir1={r[2]:.4f} hit={r[3]:.3f} adm_ic={r[4]} adm_icir={r[5]} tags={r[6]}")
EOF

    with open(f) as fh:

    print("mom npy shape:", arr.shape)

# common index range: use last 800 dates of the shortest series
ids = list(sig.keys())

print("common n_dates:", n)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

syms = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= CUTOFF].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    px[s] = df.set_index('date')['close']

PX = pd.DataFrame(px)

    r6 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-132]-1 if len(c)>132 else np.nan
    print(f"{s:<10} 1M:{r1:>8.2%}  3M:{r3:>8.2%}  6M:{r6:>8.2%}")

# 2) Trend: 20d vs 60d MA slope, and % above 200d MA
print("\n=== Trend assessment ===")
for s in syms:
    c = PX[s]
    ma20 = c.rolling(20).mean().iloc[-1]; ma60 = c.rolling(60).mean().iloc[-1]
    ma200 = c.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
    slope = (ma20/ma60 - 1)
    above200 = c.iloc[-1]/ma200 - 1 if not np.isnan(ma200) else np.nan
    print(f"{s:<10} MA20/MA60: {slope:>7.2%}  vs200dMA: {above200:>7.2%}")

# 3) Volatility
print("\n=== Realized vol (20d annualized) ===")
vol20 = rets.rolling(20).std().iloc[-1] * np.sqrt(252)
for s in syms:
    print(f"{s:<10} vol20: {vol20[s]:>7.1%}")

# avg cross-sectional dispersion of daily returns (recent 60d)
disp = rets.tail(60).std(axis=1).mean()
print(f"\nCross-sectional dispersion (60d avg): {disp:.4f}")
corr_recent = rets.tail(60).corr()
offdiag = corr_recent.values[np.triu_indices(15,1)]
print(f"Avg pairwise correlation (60d): {offdiag.mean():.3f} | median: {np.median(offdiag):.3f} | max: {offdiag.max():.3f}")

import json, base64, gzip, numpy as np, pandas as pd

CUTOFF = '2026-07-15'
files = {
 'miner2_20260715_nclv_1d': 0.25,
 'miner2_20260715_rev_1d': 0.19,
 'miner2_20260715_nclv_3d': 0.17,
 'miner2_20260715_rev_2d': 0.15,
 'miner1_20260715_rev1_x_inveff': 0.16,
 'miner2_20260716_mom_10d_skip5': 0.08,  # dir -1
}

sig = {}
meta = {}
for fid in files:
    with open(f'factors/{fid}.json') as f:
        d = json.load(f)
    sa = d.get('signal_artifact', {})
    if isinstance(sa, dict) and 'data_b64' in sa:
        raw = base64.b64decode(sa['data_b64'])
        arr = np.frombuffer(gzip.decompress(raw), dtype=np.float32).reshape(sa['n_dates'], sa['n_symbols'])
        dates = pd.date_range(sa['date_start'], sa['date_end'], freq='D') if sa['n_dates']==(pd.Timestamp(sa['date_end'])-pd.Timestamp(sa['date_start'])).days+1 else None
        # build date index from artifact range (calendar daily)
        idx = pd.date_range(sa['date_start'], sa['date_end'], freq='D')
        if len(idx) != sa['n_dates']:
            idx = pd.date_range(sa['date_start'], periods=sa['n_dates'], freq='D')
        sig[fid] = pd.DataFrame(arr, index=idx, columns=sa['symbols'])
    else:
        arr = np.load(f'factors/{fid}.npy')
        idx = pd.date_range('2020-01-01', periods=arr.shape[0], freq='D')
        sig[fid] = pd.DataFrame(arr, index=idx, columns=d.get('signal_artifact',{}).get('symbols', None) or pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/SPX.csv').assign(dummy=1).columns[:0].tolist() or None)
        # fallback symbols
        syms = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
        sig[fid].columns = syms

# load prices for returns
syms = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
px = {}
for s in syms:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{s}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= CUTOFF].set_index('date')['close']
    px[s] = df
PX = pd.DataFrame(px)
rets = PX.pct_change()

# align signals on common dates
common = None
for fid, df in sig.items():
    df = df[df.index <= CUTOFF]
    common = df.index if common is None else common.intersection(df.index)
common = common.intersection(rets.index)

combined = pd.Series(0.0, index=common)
for fid, w in files.items():
    dirn = -1 if fid=='miner2_20260716_mom_10d_skip5' else 1
    s = sig[fid].loc[common]
    # cross-sectional rank to combine fairly
    r = s.rank(axis=1, pct=True) - 0.5
    combined = combined + w * dirn * r.sum(axis=1)  # aggregate signal per date

# per-date cross-sectional IC of combined signal vs next-day returns
fwd = rets.shift(-1).loc[common]
ics = []
for dt in common:
    r = fwd.loc[dt]
    s = combined.loc[dt]
    if r.notna().sum() >= 10 and s.notna():
        ics.append((dt, np.corrcoef(s, r)[0,1]))
icdf = pd.DataFrame(ics, columns=['date','ic'])
print(f"Combined ensemble IC (next-day, cross-sectional): mean={icdf['ic'].mean():.4f}, ICIR={icdf['ic'].mean()/icdf['ic'].std()*np.sqrt(252):.3f}, hit={ (icdf['ic']>0).mean():.3f}, n={len(icdf)}")
# recent window
recent = icdf[icdf['date'] >= '2026-01-01']
print(f"2026 YTD: mean IC={recent['ic'].mean():.4f}, hit={(recent['ic']>0).mean():.3f}, n={len(recent)}")
EOF

python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, json

cutoff = '2026-07-15'
assets = ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
frames = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= cutoff].set_index('date').sort_index()
    frames[a] = df

# factor definitions (matching strategy.py)
def f_id_rev_1d(df): return -(df['close']/df['open'] - 1)
def f_nbody_1d(df): return -(df['close']-df['open'])/(df['high']-df['low'])
def f_nclv(df, w): return -(df['close']-df['low'].rolling(w).min())/(df['high'].rolling(w).max()-df['low'].rolling(w).min())
def f_rev(df, w): return -np.log(df['close']/df['close'].shift(w))
def f_rev_vs(df): 
    r = -np.log(df['close']/df['close'].shift(1))
    return r / df['close'].pct_change().rolling(20).std()
def f_mom(df, w, skip=5): return np.log(df['close'].shift(skip)/df['close'].shift(skip+w))
def f_vixbeta(df):
    vix = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv'); vix['date']=pd.to_datetime(vix['date']); vix=vix.set_index('date').sort_index()
    v = vix['close'].reindex(df.index).ffill()
    ret = df['close'].pct_change(); vret = v.pct_change()
    beta = ret.rolling(60).cov(vret)/vret.rolling(60).var()
    return -beta * (v/v.shift(20)-1)
def f_volvol(df):
    rv = df['close'].pct_change().rolling(20).std()
    return rv.rolling(60).std()

factors = {
 'miner2_20260715_id_rev_1d': lambda df: f_id_rev_1d(df),
 'miner2_20260715_nbody_1d': lambda df: f_nbody_1d(df),
 'miner2_20260715_nclv_1d': lambda df: f_nclv(df,1),
 'miner2_20260715_nclv_2d': lambda df: f_nclv(df,2),
 'miner2_20260715_nclv_3d': lambda df: f_nclv(df,3),
 'miner2_20260715_nclv_5d': lambda df: f_nclv(df,5),
 'miner2_20260715_rev_1d': lambda df: f_rev(df,1),
 'miner2_20260715_rev_1d_vs': lambda df: f_rev_vs(df),
 'miner2_20260715_rev_2d': lambda df: f_rev(df,2),
 'miner2_20260715_rev_3d': lambda df: f_rev(df,3),
 'miner2_20260715_rev_5d': lambda df: f_rev(df,5),
 'mom_10d_skip5': lambda df: f_mom(df,10),
 'mom_120d_skip5': lambda df: f_mom(df,120),
 'vix_beta_cond_60x20': lambda df: f_vixbeta(df),
 'vol_of_vol20x60': lambda df: f_volvol(df),
}

# Build signal panels
sig = {}
for fid, fn in factors.items():
    cols = {}
    for a in assets:
        try:
            s = fn(frames[a])
            cols[a] = s.replace([np.inf,-np.inf], np.nan)
        except Exception as e:
            cols[a] = pd.Series(index=frames[a].index, dtype=float)
    sig[fid] = pd.DataFrame(cols)

# Common index
common = None
for fid in sig:
    idx = sig[fid].dropna(how='all').index
    common = idx if common is None else common.intersection(idx)
print("common index:", common[0].date(), "->", common[-1].date(), "n=", len(common))

# forward 1d and 10d returns
px = pd.DataFrame({a: frames[a]['close'] for a in assets}).ffill()
ret1 = px.pct_change().shift(-1)
ret10 = px.pct_change(10).shift(-10)

# Recent IC over last 120 common dates
print("\n=== Recent 120d IC (1d and 10d fwd) vs full-sample IC1 ===")
recent = common[-120:]
for fid in sig:
    s = sig[fid].loc[recent]
    r1 = ret1.loc[recent]; r10 = ret10.loc[recent]
    ic1s = []; ic10s = []
    for dt in recent:
        row = s.loc[dt].dropna()
        r1row = r1.loc[dt].reindex(row.index).dropna()
        r10row = r10.loc[dt].reindex(row.index).dropna()
        if len(row) >= 8 and len(r1row) >= 8:
            ic1s.append(np.corrcoef(row.reindex(r1row.index), r1row)[0,1])
        if len(row) >= 8 and len(r10row) >= 8:
            ic10s.append(np.corrcoef(row.reindex(r10row.index), r10row)[0,1])
    ic1_m = np.nanmean(ic1s) if ic1s else np.nan
    ic10_m = np.nanmean(ic10s) if ic10s else np.nan
    ic1_sd = np.nanstd(ic1s) if ic1s else np.nan
    icir1 = ic1_m/ic1_sd if ic1_sd and ic1_sd>0 else np.nan
    print(f"{fid:32s} ic1_120d={ic1_m:+.4f} icir1_120d={icir1:+.3f} ic10_120d={ic10_m:+.4f}")

# Pairwise rank correlation among selected candidates (recent)
print("\n=== Factor rank correlation (last 60d, cross-sectional avg) ===")
recent60 = common[-60:]
cands = list(factors.keys())
corr = pd.DataFrame(index=cands, columns=cands, dtype=float)
for i in cands:
    for j in cands:
        cs = []
        for dt in recent60:
            a = sig[i].loc[dt]; b = sig[j].loc[dt]
            m = pd.concat([a,b],axis=1).dropna()
            if len(m) >= 8:
                cs.append(np.corrcoef(m.iloc[:,0].rank(), m.iloc[:,1].rank())[0,1])
        corr.loc[i,j] = np.nanmean(cs) if cs else np.nan
print(corr.round(2))
EOF

python -c "
import json

# Selected factors (all computable by downstream strategy.py), with validation IC / ICIR
sel = [
    ('miner2_20260715_nclv_1d',  0.0649, 0.183),
    ('miner2_20260715_rev_1d',   0.0564, 0.162),
    ('miner2_20260715_nclv_2d',  0.0530, 0.169),
    ('miner2_20260715_nclv_3d',  0.0512, 0.165),
    ('miner2_20260715_nbody_1d', 0.0528, 0.149),
    ('miner2_20260715_rev_2d',   0.0510, 0.146),
    ('mom_10d_skip5',            0.0409, 0.1183),
]
q = {fid: abs(ic)*abs(icir) for fid, ic, icir in sel}
tot = sum(q.values())
w = {fid: q[fid]/tot for fid, _, _ in sel}

# Risk overlay: cap turnover-heavy mom_10d_skip5 at 0.06, redistribute excess by q
CAP = 0.06
if w['mom_10d_skip5'] > CAP:
    excess = w['mom_10d_skip5'] - CAP
    w['mom_10d_skip5'] = CAP
    others = [fid for fid, _, _ in sel if fid != 'mom_10d_skip5']
    otot = sum(w[fid] for fid in others)
    for fid in others:
        w[fid] += excess * w[fid] / otot

# normalize to exactly 1
tot = sum(w.values())
w = {fid: x/tot for fid, x in w.items()}

out = {'schema_version': 1,
       'selected_factors': [{'factor_id': fid, 'weight': round(w[fid], 6), 'direction': 1}
                            for fid, _, _ in sel],
       'method': 'quality_ic_tilt'}
print('sum weight =', sum(x['weight'] for x in out['selected_factors']))
for x in out['selected_factors']:
    print(x)
with open('factor_ensemble.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
print('written factor_ensemble.json')
"

]

python - <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

assets = ["000300.SH","SPX","HSI","N225","SX5E","000688.SH","SOX","NDX","XAU","COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]
frames = {}
for a in assets:
    p = f"../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv"
    if os.path.exists(p):
        df = pd.read_csv(p)
        df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
        df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
        df = df.sort_values('date').set_index('date')
        frames[a] = df

last_date = max(df.index.max() for df in frames.values())
print("Last data date:", last_date.date())

rets = {}
vols = {}
slope = {}
for a, df in frames.items():
    c = df['close'].astype(float)
    r = c.pct_change().dropna()
    rets[a] = r.tail(20).mean()
    vols[a] = r.tail(20).std() * np.sqrt(252)
    m = c.tail(60)
    slope[a] = (m.iloc[-1]/m.iloc[0] - 1)  # 60d total return as trend proxy

print("\n%-10s %10s %10s %10s" % ("asset","ret20d","annvol","60d_trend"))
for a in assets:
    print("%-10s %10.4f %10.4f %10.4f" % (a, rets[a], vols[a], slope[a]))

# Pairwise correlation of daily returns (last 63 and 21 days)
R = pd.DataFrame({a: frames[a]['close'].astype(float).pct_change() for a in assets})
R = R.replace([np.inf,-np.inf], np.nan).dropna(how='all')
c63 = R.tail(63).corr().values[np.triu_indices(15,1)]
c21 = R.tail(21).corr().values[np.triu_indices(15,1)]
print("\nAvg pairwise corr 63d: %.4f | 21d: %.4f" % (np.nanmean(c63), np.nanmean(c21)))

# VIX level
vix = pd.read_csv("../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv")
vix.columns = [c.strip() for c in vix.columns]
vix['date'] = pd.to_datetime(vix['date'])
vix = vix.sort_values('date')
print("VIX last:", vix['close'].iloc[-1], "| 5d ago:", vix['close'].iloc[-6])

# Dispersion of 20d returns
print("Cross-sectional dispersion of ret20d: %.4f" % np.std(list(rets.values())))

import json, glob, os

active = sorted(f for f in glob.glob('factors/*.json') if not f.endswith('.bak'))
rows = []
for f in active:
    d = json.load(open(f))
    fid = d['factor_id']
    m = d['validation']['metrics']
    if isinstance(m, dict):
        ic = m.get('ic1') or m.get('ic') or m.get('IC') or m.get('ic_mean')
        icir = m.get('icir1') or m.get('icir') or m.get('ICIR') or m.get('ic_ir')
    else:
        ic = icir = None
    # find nested
    if ic is None and isinstance(m, dict):
        for k in ('ic1','ic','IC','ic_mean','mean_ic'):
            if k in m: ic = m[k]
    if icir is None and isinstance(m, dict):
        for k in ('icir1','icir','ICIR','ic_ir','mean_icir'):
            if k in m: icir = m[k]
    rows.append((fid, ic, icir, m if isinstance(m,(int,float)) else None))
    print(f"{fid:40s} ic={ic} icir={icir}")

print("\n--- q-tilt recomputation ---")
qrows = []
for fid, ic, icir in rows:

python - <<'EOF'
import json, glob

def find_ic(m):
    if not isinstance(m, dict): return None
    for k in ('ic1','ic','IC','ic_mean','mean_ic'):
        if k in m and isinstance(m[k], (int,float)): return m[k]
    for v in m.values():
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            r = find_ic(v)
            if r is not None: return r
    return None

def find_icir(m):
    if not isinstance(m, dict): return None
    for k in ('icir1','icir','ICIR','ic_ir','mean_icir','icir_mean'):
        if k in m and isinstance(m[k], (int,float)): return m[k]
    for v in m.values():
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            r = find_icir(v)
            if r is not None: return r
    return None

active = sorted(f for f in glob.glob('factors/*.json') if not f.endswith('.bak'))
rows = []
for f in active:
    d = json.load(open(f))
    fid = d['factor_id']
    m = d['validation']['metrics']
    ic = find_ic(m); icir = find_icir(m)
    rows.append((fid, ic, icir))
    print(f"{fid:40s} ic={ic} icir={icir}")

print("\n--- q-tilt recomputation ---")
qrows = []
for fid, ic, icir in rows:
    if ic is None or icir is None:
        print(f"{fid}: missing metrics, skip")
        continue
    q = abs(float(ic)) * abs(float(icir))
    sign = 1 if float(ic) > 0 else -1
    qrows.append((fid, q, sign))
qrows.sort(key=lambda t: -t[1])
tot = sum(q for _, q, _ in qrows)
print("\nRanked by q = abs(IC)*abs(ICIR):")
for fid, q, s in qrows:
    print(f"  {fid:40s} q={q:.6f} sign={s}")

print("\n--- Persisted ensemble check ---")
ens = json.load(open('factor_ensemble.json'))['selected_factors']
ens_ids = [x['factor_id'] for x in ens]
# recompute weights for the 7 selected
sel = [r for r in qrows if r[0] in ens_ids]
sel_tot = sum(q for _, q, _ in sel)
print("Selected set weights (q-tilt):")
maxdiff = 0
for fid, q, s in sel:
    w = q / sel_tot
    pw = next(x['weight'] for x in ens if x['factor_id'] == fid)
    maxdiff = max(maxdiff, abs(w - pw))
    print(f"  {fid:40s} recomputed={w:.6f} persisted={pw:.6f} diff={abs(w-pw):.2e}")
print(f"Max weight diff: {maxdiff:.2e}")
EOF

import json, glob, os, math

def load_metric(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        d = json.load(f)
    vm = d.get('validation', {}).get('metrics', {})
    ic = vm.get('IC', vm.get('ic', vm.get('ic1'))); icir = vm.get('ICIR', vm.get('icir', vm.get('icir1')))
    return ic, icir

rows = {}
for path in sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json')):
    if path.endswith('.bak'): continue
    fid = os.path.basename(path)[:-5]
    ic, icir = load_metric(path)
    if ic is not None and icir is not None:
        rows[fid] = (ic, icir, abs(ic)*abs(icir))

# Correctly-implementable set: exact branch match, excluding id_rev_1d (would map to rev_1d branch = formula mismatch)
IMPLEMENTABLE = ['miner2_20260715_nclv_1d','miner2_20260715_nclv_2d','miner2_20260715_nclv_3d',
                 'miner2_20260715_rev_1d','miner2_20260715_rev_2d','miner2_20260715_nbody_1d',
                 'mom_10d_skip5']
sub = {fid: rows[fid] for fid in IMPLEMENTABLE}
tot = sum(v[2] for v in sub.values())
recomp = {fid: v[2]/tot for fid, v in sub.items()}

with open('factor_ensemble.json') as f:
    ens = json.load(f)
sel = {f['factor_id']: f['weight'] for f in ens['selected_factors']}

print('Correctly-implementable subset (n=%d), sum q = %.8f' % (len(sub), tot))
maxdiff = 0.0
for fid in sorted(sel):
    d = abs(recomp[fid] - sel[fid]); maxdiff = max(maxdiff, d)
    print('  %-32s q_w=%.6f ens=%.6f diff=%.2e' % (fid, recomp[fid], sel[fid], d))
print('MAX DIFF = %.2e' % maxdiff)
print('Ensemble set == implementable set:', set(sel) == set(sub))
print('Weights non-negative:', all(f['weight'] >= 0 for f in ens['selected_factors']), '| sum=1:', abs(sum(sel.values())-1) < 1e-9)
print('All directions +1:', all(f['direction'] == 1 for f in ens['selected_factors']))
# q ranking of excluded but high-q factors
print('\nExcluded factors with q >= selected min (%.6f):' % min(v[2] for v in sub.values()))
for fid, (ic, icir, q) in sorted(rows.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1][2]):
    if fid not in sub and q >= min(v[2] for v in sub.values()):
        print('  %-32s q=%.6f -> implementable_in_trader=%s' % (fid, q, fid.endswith('rev_1d') or 'mom_10d_skip5' in fid))
EOF

import json, glob, os

files = [f for f in glob.glob('factors/*.json') if not f.endswith('.bak')]

    ic1 = m.get("ic1", m.get("ic")); icir1 = m.get("icir1", m.get("icir"))
    cov = m.get("coverage", m.get("coverage_dates_ge8"))
    to = m.get("turnover_10d", m.get("turnover_10d_rank"))
    maxcorr = m.get("max_abs_library_correlation")
    if isinstance(ic1,(int,float)) and isinstance(icir1,(int,float)):
        q = abs(ic1)*abs(icir1)
    else:
        q = None
    rows.append((fid, ic1, icir1, q, cov, to, maxcorr))

hdr = f"{'factor':<34}{'ic1':>8}{'icir1':>8}{'q':>11}{'cov':>7}{'turn10d':>9}{'maxcorr':>8}"
print(hdr)
for r in sorted(rows, key=lambda x: -(x[3] or 0.0)):
    qs = "None" if r[3] is None else f"{r[3]:.6f}"
    print(f"{r[0]:<34}{str(r[1]):>8}{str(r[2]):>8}{qs:>11}{str(r[4]):>7}{str(r[5]):>9}{str(r[6]):>8}")

impl = ["miner2_20260715_nclv_1d","miner2_20260715_rev_1d","miner2_20260715_nclv_2d",
        "miner2_20260715_nclv_3d","miner2_20260715_nbody_1d","miner2_20260715_rev_2d",
        "mom_10d_skip5"]
qmap = {r[0]: r[3] for r in rows}
qs = [qmap[f] for f in impl]
tot = sum(qs)
print("\n=== Q-TILT OVER IMPLEMENTABLE 7 ===")
for f, q in zip(impl, qs):
    print(f"  {f:<34} q={q:.6f}  w={q/tot:.6f}")
print("  sum =", round(sum(q/tot for q in qs), 8))

with open('factor_ensemble.json') as f:
    ens = json.load(f)
persist_w = {s['factor_id']: s['weight'] for s in ens['selected_factors']}
print("\n=== CHECK vs PERSISTED ===")
maxdiff = 0.0
for f, q in zip(impl, qs):
    w = q/tot
    pw = persist_w.get(f)
    diff = abs(w - pw) if pw is not None else float('inf')
    maxdiff = max(maxdiff, diff)
    print(f"  {f:<34} recomputed={w:.6f} persisted={pw} diff={diff:.2e}")
print("max abs diff:", maxdiff)
print("persisted set == recomputed set:", set(persist_w) == set(impl))
EOF

import json, glob, os

# Implementable factor-ID branches in trader strategy.py _factor_values
def implementable(fid):
    return (fid.endswith("nclv_1d") or fid.endswith("nclv_2d") or fid.endswith("nclv_3d")
            or fid.endswith("rev_1d") or fid.endswith("rev_2d")
            or fid.endswith("nbody_1d") or "mom_10d_skip5" in fid)

# NOTE: id_rev_1d ends with "rev_1d" -> collides with the close-to-close branch;
# exclude explicitly (validated formula is intraday, not close-to-close)
HAZARD_SUFFIX = {"miner2_20260715_id_rev_1d"}

files = sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json'))
files = [f for f in files if not f.endswith('.bak')]

rows = []
for f in files:
    fid = os.path.basename(f).replace('.json','')
    with open(f) as fh:
        d = json.load(fh)
    vm = d.get('validation', {}).get('metrics', {})
    ic = vm.get('ic1', vm.get('ic'))
    icir = vm.get('icir1', vm.get('icir'))
    if ic is None or icir is None:
        continue
    q = abs(ic) * abs(icir)
    imp = implementable(fid) and fid not in HAZARD_SUFFIX
    rows.append((fid, ic, icir, q, imp))

print(f"{'factor_id':35s} {'IC':>7s} {'ICIR':>7s} {'q':>9s}  imp")
for fid, ic, icir, q, imp in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: -r[3]):
    print(f"{fid:35s} {ic:7.4f} {icir:7.4f} {q:9.6f}  {'YES' if imp else 'no '}")

# Build q-tilt over implementable set
impl = [(fid, ic, icir, q) for fid, ic, icir, q, imp in rows if imp]
tot = sum(r[3] for r in impl)
print("\nImplementable count:", len(impl), "| sum q:", round(tot, 6))
sel = [{"factor_id": fid, "weight": round(q/tot, 6), "direction": 1 if ic >= 0 else -1}
       for fid, ic, icir, q in sorted(impl, key=lambda r: -r[3])]
ens = {"schema_version": 1, "selected_factors": sel, "method": "quality_ic_tilt"}
print("Recomputed weights sum:", round(sum(s['weight'] for s in sel), 6))

with open('factor_ensemble.json') as fh:
    prev = json.load(fh)
print("Identical to persisted:", ens == prev)
EOF

"""Screener cycle 2026-08-27: regime assessment + IC/ICIR recompute on visible data.

Visible horizon: last common trading date <= 2026-08-26 (previous completed day).
Methodology mirrors miner3_fast.fast_ic (daily cross-sectional rank IC, ICIR=mean/std).
"""
import sys, os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from miner1_common import SYMBOLS, MACRO, DATA_DIR, IDX_DIR

CUT = pd.Timestamp("2026-08-26")
START = pd.Timestamp("2021-01-01")  # validation window start (as miner pipeline)
MIN_NAMES = 8

# ---------- load ----------
def load_all():
    frames = {}
    for s in SYMBOLS:
        d = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, f"{s}.csv"))
        d["date"] = pd.to_datetime(d["date"])
        d = d[d["date"] <= CUT].sort_values("date").set_index("date")
        for col in ["open", "high", "low", "close", "volume"]:
            if col in d.columns:
                d[col] = pd.to_numeric(d[col], errors="coerce")
        frames[s] = d
    # common calendar
    idx = None
    for s, df in frames.items():
        idx = df.index if idx is None else idx.intersection(df.index)
    idx = idx[idx >= pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01")]
    CP = pd.DataFrame({s: frames[s]["close"].reindex(idx).astype(float) for s in SYMBOLS})
    OP = pd.DataFrame({s: frames[s]["open"].reindex(idx).astype(float) for s in SYMBOLS})
    HP = pd.DataFrame({s: frames[s]["high"].reindex(idx).astype(float) for s in SYMBOLS})
    LP = pd.DataFrame({s: frames[s]["low"].reindex(idx).astype(float) for s in SYMBOLS})
    # VIX (observation-only macro)
    vix = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(IDX_DIR, "VIX.csv"))
    vix["date"] = pd.to_datetime(vix["date"])
    vix = vix[vix["date"] <= CUT].sort_values("date").set_index("date")
    vixc = vix["close"].astype(float).reindex(idx)
    return idx, CP, OP, HP, LP, vixc

idx, CP, OP, HP, LP, VIXC = load_all()
RET = CP.pct_change()
print(f"common dates: {len(idx)}  {idx.min().date()}..{idx.max().date()}")
print(f"last date: {idx.max().date()}")

# ---------- factor panels ----------
def fwd_returns(fwd_days=1):
    return CP.shift(-fwd_days) / CP - 1.0

def fast_ic(factor_df, fwd_df, min_names=MIN_NAMES):
    F = factor_df.reindex(idx).astype(float)
    R = fwd_df.reindex(idx).astype(float)
    F = F.rank(axis=1); R = R.rank(axis=1)
    Fv, Rv = F.values, R.values
    mask = np.isfinite(Fv) & np.isfinite(Rv)
    n = mask.sum(axis=1)
    ok = n >= min_names
    if not ok.any():

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
rows = []
for fp in files:
    a = fp.split('/')[-1].replace('.csv','')
    df = pd.read_csv(fp)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    c = df['close'].astype(float)
    ret = c.pct_change()
    last = df['date'].iloc[-1]
    r20 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-21]-1 if len(c)>21 else np.nan
    r60 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-61]-1 if len(c)>61 else np.nan
    r120 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-121]-1 if len(c)>121 else np.nan
    vol20 = ret.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
    vol60 = ret.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
    # MA slope: (MA10 today - MA10 20d ago)/MA10
    ma10 = c.rolling(10).mean()
    slope = (ma10.iloc[-1]/ma10.iloc[-21]-1) if len(ma10)>21 else np.nan
    rows.append((a, str(last.date()), r20, r60, r120, vol20, vol60, slope))
print('%-10s %-12s %8s %8s %8s %8s %8s %8s' % ('asset','last','r20','r60','r120','vol20','vol60','MA10slope'))
for r in rows:
    print('%-10s %-12s %8.4f %8.4f %8.4f %8.4f %8.4f %8.4f' % (r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[5], r[6], r[7]))
"

### Market Assessment
- **Overall trend: Sideways-to-Bear (risk-off tilt).** Mean 20d daily return across the 15-asset panel ≈ +0.04% (strategy's `_regime` → "side"), but this masks extreme dispersion: 10d returns range **WTI −22.2% / SPX −12.3% / HSI −6.7%** to **ETH +18.6% / XAU +7.9% / N225 +7.9% / COPPER +5.3%**. - **Risk level: High** (commodity vol 53% ann. for WTI, ETH 72%; SOX 44%), though VIX itself is low (12.9).
- **Regime conclusion:** High-dispersion, partially trending, risk-off tape → **favor momentum/trend + defensive/low-beta factors; penalize 1d short-horizon reversal** (which keeps buying falling knives like WTI/SPX).

### Available Factors (active library, 14 factors — audit cycle 69 kept 14; `mom_10d_skip5` officially evicted)
- **Mean-reversion/Reversal:** nclv_1d/2d/3d/5d, rev_1d/2d/3d/5d, rev_1d_vs, id_rev_1d, nbody_1d

Quality = q = |IC|·|ICIR| (revalidated 2026-10-30 metrics where available; 10d-horizon IC for block-matched factors), then regime overlay (reversal ×0.6, momentum ×2.2, vol/defensive ×1.2–1.4):

- **Crowding (empirical, recent 60d rank-corr):** nbody_1d ≡ nclv_1d (corr **1.00** — pure duplication, dropped); rev_1d vs nclv_1d 0.91 (dropped); nclv_3d vs nclv_2d 0.91 (dropped). Previous ensemble silently carried a 1.00-correlated pair.

- Cycles 2–4: reversal ensemble lost 3 consecutive blocks (−2.29%, −1.54%; worst WTI/XAU overweighted then extended lower) → **"trim reversal-family share, add trend/momentum guard"** — implemented here at the ensemble level (mom 36%).
- Cycle 5 block (10-16→10-30, strategy v2 with trend overlay) was **+0.91%** with the old 92% reversal ensemble — the overlay helped; the new ensemble should reduce reliance on that overlay fighting the signal.

- **Suggestion:** consider demoting `rev_5d` (2026 IC −0.042) and `rev_3d`/`nclv_5d` (2026 IC ≈ 0) at the next library cycle; they are stale holdovers.

import pandas as pd, glob, os, math
CUT = '2026-11-26'
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
rows=[]
for f in files:
    name = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv','')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= CUT].sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
    c = df['close'].astype(float)
    if len(c) < 70:
        print(name, 'INSUFFICIENT', len(c)); continue
    def ret(n):
        return c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-1-n]-1 if len(c)>n else float('nan')
    vol20 = c.pct_change().tail(20).std()*math.sqrt(252)
    vol63 = c.pct_change().tail(63).std()*math.sqrt(252)
    ma20 = c.tail(20).mean(); ma60 = c.tail(60).mean()
    # trend streak: sign of last 10 daily returns
    streak = sum(1 for r in c.pct_change().tail(10) if r > 0)
    rows.append((name, str(df['date'].iloc[-1].date()), round(c.iloc[-1],2),
                 round(ret(5)*100,2), round(ret(21)*100,2), round(ret(63)*100,2),
                 round(vol20*100,1), round(vol63*100,1), round((ma20/ma60-1)*100,1), streak))
out = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['asset','last_date','last','r5%','r21%','r63%','vol20%','vol63%','ma20/ma60%','up10d'])
print(out.to_string(index=False))
EOF

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

# Load 15 watchlist CSVs, filter to rows <= 2026-12-24 (visible through)
assets = ["000300.SH","000688.SH","SPX","HSI","N225","SX5E","SOX","NDX","XAU","COPPER","WTI","BTC","ETH","US10Y","CN10Y"]
px = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f"../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv")
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    datecol = df.columns[0]
    df[datecol] = pd.to_datetime(df[datecol].astype(str))
    df = df[df[datecol] <= "2026-12-24"].sort_values(datecol).reset_index(drop=True)
    px[a] = df

# Build close matrix
closes = pd.DataFrame({a: px[a].iloc[:, 2].values for a in assets}, index=px[assets[0]].iloc[:,0])
closes.index = pd.to_datetime(closes.index)
rets = closes.pct_change()

# Last date
print("last visible date:", closes.index[-1].date())

# Trend: 120d and 60d returns, MA slope
for a in assets:
    c = closes[a]
    r120 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-126]-1 if len(c)>126 else np.nan
    r60 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-61]-1 if len(c)>61 else np.nan
    r20 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-21]-1 if len(c)>21 else np.nan
    print(f"{a:10s} r20={r20:+.3f} r60={r60:+.3f} r120={r120:+.3f}")

# Vol regime: 20d realized vol annualized average cross-section
vol20 = rets.tail(20).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print("\nmean 20d ann vol:", (vol20.mean()).round(3), "| median:", vol20.median().round(3))
vol60 = rets.tail(60).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print("mean 60d ann vol:", (vol60.mean()).round(3))

# Correlation regime: mean pairwise corr of 10d returns over last 60d
corr10 = rets.tail(60).rolling(10).corr()
# simpler: pairwise corr of daily rets over last 60d
cmat = rets.tail(60).corr()
np.fill_diagonal(cmat.values, np.nan)
print("\nmean pairwise corr (60d daily):", np.nanmean(cmat.values).round(3))

# Dispersion: cross-sectional std of 10d returns
cs_std = rets.tail(60).std(axis=1)
print("mean daily cross-sectional std (60d):", cs_std.mean().round(4))

# Equity index trend strength: SPX MA20 slope
c = closes["SPX"]
ma20 = c.rolling(20).mean()
slope = (ma20.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-6]-1)
print("\nSPX MA20 5d slope:", round(slope,4), "| price vs MA20:", round(c.iloc[-1]/ma20.iloc[-1]-1,4))

CUTOFF = '2027-01-07'

import json, pickle
import pandas as pd, numpy as np

with open('scripts/panel_cache.pkl','rb') as fh:
    pc = pickle.load(fh)
close = pc['close']; open_ = pc['open']; high = pc['high']; low = pc['low']; ret = pc['ret']; macro = pc['macro']

# reconstruct factors per library calc expressions
def factor_signals():
    sigs = {}
    # reversal family
    for nd in [1,2,3,5]:
        sigs[f'miner2_20260715_rev_{nd}d'] = -ret.shift(1).rolling(nd).sum()  # short-term reversal nd (skip today)
    # intraday reversal 1d
    sigs['miner2_20260715_id_rev_1d'] = -(close - open_)/open_
    # negative intraday body 1d
    sigs['miner2_20260715_nbody_1d'] = -(close - open_)/ (high - low).replace(0,np.nan)
    # negative close location value nd
    for nd in [1,2,3,5]:
        rng = high.rolling(nd).max() - low.rolling(nd).min()
        sigs[f'miner2_20260715_nclv_{nd}d'] = -(close - low.rolling(nd).min())/rng.replace(0,np.nan)
    # vol-scaled reversal 1d
    vol20 = ret.pct_change() if False else ret  # ret already returns
    rv = ret.rolling(20).std()
    sigs['miner2_20260715_rev_1d_vs'] = -ret.shift(1)/rv.shift(1).replace(0,np.nan)
    # momentum 120d skip5
    sigs['mom_120d_skip5'] = close.shift(5)/close.shift(125) - 1.0
    # vol of vol 20x60
    sigs['vol_of_vol20x60'] = ret.rolling(20).std().rolling(60).std()
    # vix beta cond 60x20 (uses macro VIX)
    vix = macro['VIX'].reindex(close.index).ffill()
    vix_ret = vix.pct_change()
    # beta of asset ret vs vix_ret over 60d
    cov = ret.rolling(60).cov(vix_ret)
    var = vix_ret.rolling(60).var()
    beta = cov.div(var.replace(0,np.nan), axis=0)
    sigs['vix_beta_cond_60x20'] = -beta * (vix/vix.shift(20) - 1.0)
    return sigs

sigs = factor_signals()

def rank_ic(sig, fwd, dates):
    # cross-sectional Spearman IC per date, then mean
    ics = []
    for dt in dates:
        s = sig.loc[dt]
        f = fwd.loc[dt]
        m = s.notna() & f.notna()
        if m.sum() >= 8:
            ics.append(scipy_spearman(s[m], f[m]))
    return np.mean(ics), np.std(ics)/np.sqrt(max(len(ics),1)), len(ics)

from scipy.stats import spearmanr as scipy_spearman

fwd1 = ret.shift(-1)
all_dates = close.index
recent63 = all_dates[-63:]
recent126 = all_dates[-126:]
recent21 = all_dates[-21:]

print(f"{'factor':32s} {'IC63':>7s} {'ICIR63':>7s} {'IC126':>7s} {'ICIR126':>7s} {'IC21':>7s} {'n63':>4s}")

import json, base64, zlib, pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

END = pd.Timestamp('2027-02-04')
files = sorted(glob.glob('factors/*.json'))
assets = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','BTC','CN10Y','COPPER','ETH','HSI','N225','NDX','SOX','SPX','SX5E','US10Y','WTI','XAU']
assert len(assets)==15

# price panel
PX = pd.DataFrame()
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df.columns = ['date','open','close','high','low','volume','change','pct_change'] + list(df.columns[8:])
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df[df['date'] <= END].set_index('date').sort_index()
    PX[a] = df['close']
PX = PX.dropna(how='all')
fwd1 = PX.shift(-1)/PX - 1
fwd5 = PX.shift(-5)/PX - 1
fwd10 = PX.shift(-10)/PX - 1

def spearman_ic(fv, fwd):
    m = pd.concat([fv, fwd], axis=1).dropna()
    if len(m) < 8: return np.nan
    return m.iloc[:,0].corr(m.iloc[:,1], method='spearman')

print(f"{'factor':<30} {'fullIC':>7} {'fullICIR':>8} {'ic1_60':>7} {'ic1_20':>7} {'ic5_60':>7} {'ic10_60':>7} {'ic10_20':>7}")
results = {}
for f in files:
    d = json.load(open(f))
    fid = d['factor_id']
    v = d.get('validation', {})
    m = v.get('metrics', {})
    full_ic = m.get('ic', m.get('ic1', np.nan))
    full_icir = m.get('icir', m.get('icir1', np.nan))
    art = v.get('signal_artifact')
    if not art:
        print(f'{fid:<30} no artifact'); continue
    raw = base64.b64decode(art['data']); csv = zlib.decompress(raw).decode()
    df = pd.read_csv(io := __import__('io').StringIO(csv), parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date')
    df = df[df.index <= END]
    fv = df[assets]
    ic1_60 = np.nanmean([spearman_ic(fv.iloc[i], fwd1.iloc[i]) for i in range(max(0,len(fv)-60), len(fv))])
    ic1_20 = np.nanmean([spearman_ic(fv.iloc[i], fwd1.iloc[i]) for i in range(max(0,len(fv)-20), len(fv))])
    ic5_60 = np.nanmean([spearman_ic(fv.iloc[i], fwd5.iloc[i]) for i in range(max(0,len(fv)-60), len(fv))])
    ic10_60 = np.nanmean([spearman_ic(fv.iloc[i], fwd10.iloc[i]) for i in range(max(0,len(fv)-60), len(fv))])
    ic10_20 = np.nanmean([spearman_ic(fv.iloc[i], fwd10.iloc[i]) for i in range(max(0,len(fv)-20), len(fv))])
    results[fid] = dict(full_ic=full_ic, full_icir=full_icir, ic1_60=ic1_60, ic1_20=ic1_20, ic5_60=ic5_60, ic10_60=ic10_60, ic10_20=ic10_20)
    print(f'{fid:<30} {full_ic:7.4f} {full_icir:8.3f} {ic1_60:7.4f} {ic1_20:7.4f} {ic5_60:7.4f} {ic10_60:7.4f} {ic10_20:7.4f}')

json.dump(results, open('screener_recent_ic.json','w'), indent=1, default=str)
print('\nsaved screener_recent_ic.json')
EOF

"""Screener 2027-03-05: independent factor IC check via simulator API (same source as strategy.py).

Computes cross-sectional Spearman IC (1d forward) for each library factor over:
  - w26: 2026-08-01..2027-03-04 (post-warmup live window)
  - recent: last 250 trading days
  - full: 2021-01-01..2027-03-04
Uses get_stock_daily_data (API) so calendar/data match the live strategy.
Read-only; does not touch account/date or the step/backtest tools.
"""
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data

WATCH = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX",
         "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
MIN_VALID = 8
DAYS = 600

frames = {}
for a in WATCH:
    df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=a, days=DAYS)
    if df is None or len(df) < 200:
        continue
    df = df.copy()
    df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
    df = df.set_index("date").sort_index()
    frames[a] = df

idx = sorted(set().union(*[set(f.index) for f in frames.values()]))
idx = pd.DatetimeIndex([d for d in idx if pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01") <= d <= pd.Timestamp("2027-03-04")])

C = pd.DataFrame(index=idx, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
O = pd.DataFrame(index=idx, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
H = pd.DataFrame(index=idx, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
L = pd.DataFrame(index=idx, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
for a in WATCH:
    if a in frames:
        f = frames[a]
        C.loc[f.index, a] = f["close"].values
        O.loc[f.index, a] = f["open"].values
        H.loc[f.index, a] = f["high"].values
        L.loc[f.index, a] = f["low"].values
C = C.ffill(); O = O.ffill(); H = H.ffill(); L = L.ffill()
R = C.pct_change()
lnC = np.log(C)

def build(fid):
    fdf = pd.DataFrame(index=C.index, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
    for a in WATCH:
        c, o, h, l = C[a], O[a], H[a], L[a]
        if fid == "nclv_1d":
            fdf[a] = -(c - l) / (h - l)
        elif fid == "nclv_2d":
            fdf[a] = -(c - l.rolling(2).min()) / (h.rolling(2).max() - l.rolling(2).min())
        elif fid == "nclv_3d":
            fdf[a] = -(c - l.rolling(3).min()) / (h.rolling(3).max() - l.rolling(3).min())
        elif fid == "nclv_5d":
            fdf[a] = -(c - l.rolling(5).min()) / (h.rolling(5).max() - l.rolling(5).min())
        elif fid == "rev_1d":
            fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(1)
        elif fid == "rev_2d":
            fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(2)
        elif fid == "rev_3d":
            fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(3)
        elif fid == "rev_5d":
            fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(5)
        elif fid == "nbody_1d":
            fdf[a] = -(c - o) / (h - l)
        elif fid == "id_rev_1d":
            fdf[a] = -(c / o - 1.0)
        elif fid == "rev_1d_vs":
            fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(1) / R[a].rolling(20).std()
        elif fid == "mom_120d_skip5":
            fdf[a] = c.shift(5) / c.shift(125) - 1.0
        elif fid == "vol_of_vol20x60":
            fdf[a] = R[a].rolling(20).std().rolling(60).std()
        else:
            return None
    return fdf.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

def daily_ic(fdf, fwd=1):
    fr = C.shift(-fwd) / C - 1.0
    out = []
    for i in range(len(fdf)):
        fv = fdf.iloc[i].values
        rv = fr.iloc[i].values
        m = np.isfinite(fv) & np.isfinite(rv)
        if m.sum() < MIN_VALID:
            continue
        rho = spearmanr(fv[m], rv[m]).correlation
        out.append(rho if np.isfinite(rho) else np.nan)
    return np.array(out)

def stats(ic):
    ok = np.isfinite(ic)
    if ok.sum() < 20:
        return dict(n=int(ok.sum()), ic=np.nan, icir=np.nan)
    ic = ic[ok]
    return dict(n=int(ok.sum()), ic=float(np.nanmean(ic)),
                icir=float(np.nanmean(ic) / np.nanstd(ic)))

fids = ["rev_1d", "rev_2d", "rev_3d", "rev_5d", "nclv_1d", "nclv_2d", "nclv_3d",
        "nclv_5d", "nbody_1d", "id_rev_1d", "rev_1d_vs", "mom_120d_skip5", "vol_of_vol20x60"]
print(f"{'factor':<16}{'full_ic':>9}{'full_icir':>10}{'rec_ic':>9}{'rec_icir':>10}{'w26_ic':>9}{'w26_icir':>10}{'w26_n':>7}")
for fid in fids:
    fdf = build(fid)
    if fdf is None:
        continue
    full = fdf.loc["2021-01-01":]
    ic_f = daily_ic(full)
    ic_r = daily_ic(full.iloc[-250:])
    ic_w = daily_ic(full.loc["2026-08-01":])
    s_f, s_r, s_w = stats(ic_f), stats(ic_r), stats(ic_w)
    print(f"{fid:<16}{s_f['ic']:>+9.4f}{s_f['icir']:>+10.3f}{s_r['ic']:>+9.4f}{s_r['icir']:>+10.3f}{s_w['ic']:>+9.4f}{s_w['icir']:>+10.3f}{s_w['n']:>7d}")

"""Screener 2027-03-19 cycle: API-based factor IC at 1/5/10d horizons (matches live holding cadence),
factor correlation, and market regime assessment. Data through last completed trading day 2027-03-18."""
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data

WATCH = ["000300.SH", "SPX", "HSI", "N225", "SX5E", "000688.SH", "SOX", "NDX",
         "XAU", "COPPER", "WTI", "BTC", "ETH", "US10Y", "CN10Y"]
MIN_VALID = 8
DAYS = 700
END = pd.Timestamp("2027-03-18")

frames = {}
for a in WATCH:
    df = get_stock_daily_data(symbol=a, days=DAYS)
    if df is None or len(df) < 200:
        continue
    df = df.copy(); df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
    df = df.set_index("date").sort_index()
    frames[a] = df

idx = sorted(set().union(*[set(f.index) for f in frames.values()]))
idx = pd.DatetimeIndex([d for d in idx if pd.Timestamp("2020-01-01") <= d <= END])
C = pd.DataFrame(index=idx, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
O = pd.DataFrame(index=idx, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
H = pd.DataFrame(index=idx, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
L = pd.DataFrame(index=idx, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
for a in WATCH:
    if a in frames:
        f = frames[a]
        C.loc[f.index, a] = f["close"].values
        O.loc[f.index, a] = f["open"].values
        H.loc[f.index, a] = f["high"].values
        L.loc[f.index, a] = f["low"].values
C = C.ffill(); O = O.ffill(); H = H.ffill(); L = L.ffill()
R = C.pct_change()
lnC = np.log(C)

VIX = pd.read_csv("../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv")
VIX["date"] = pd.to_datetime(VIX["date"])
VIX = VIX[VIX["date"] <= END].set_index("date")["close"].astype(float)

def build(fid):
    fdf = pd.DataFrame(index=C.index, columns=WATCH, dtype=float)
    for a in WATCH:
        c, o, h, l = C[a], O[a], H[a], L[a]
        if fid == "nclv_1d": fdf[a] = -(c - l) / (h - l)
        elif fid == "nclv_2d": fdf[a] = -(c - l.rolling(2).min()) / (h.rolling(2).max() - l.rolling(2).min())
        elif fid == "nclv_3d": fdf[a] = -(c - l.rolling(3).min()) / (h.rolling(3).max() - l.rolling(3).min())
        elif fid == "nclv_5d": fdf[a] = -(c - l.rolling(5).min()) / (h.rolling(5).max() - l.rolling(5).min())
        elif fid == "rev_1d": fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(1)
        elif fid == "rev_2d": fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(2)
        elif fid == "rev_3d": fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(3)
        elif fid == "rev_5d": fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(5)
        elif fid == "nbody_1d": fdf[a] = -(c - o) / (h - l)
        elif fid == "id_rev_1d": fdf[a] = -(c / o - 1.0)
        elif fid == "rev_1d_vs": fdf[a] = -lnC[a].diff(1) / R[a].rolling(20).std()
        elif fid == "mom_120d_skip5": fdf[a] = c.shift(5) / c.shift(125) - 1.0
        elif fid == "vol_of_vol20x60": fdf[a] = R[a].rolling(20).std().rolling(60).std()
        elif fid == "vix_beta_cond_60x20":
            v = VIX.reindex(C.index).ffill()
            ar = c.pct_change(); vr = v.pct_change()
            beta = ar.rolling(60).cov(vr) / vr.rolling(60).var()
            vm = v / v.shift(20) - 1.0
            fdf[a] = -beta * vm
        else: return None
    return fdf.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)

def daily_ic(fdf, fwd):
    fr = C.shift(-fwd) / C - 1.0
    out = []
    for i in range(len(fdf)):
        fv = fdf.iloc[i].values; rv = fr.iloc[i].values
        m = np.isfinite(fv) & np.isfinite(rv)
        if m.sum() < MIN_VALID: continue
        if np.all(fv[m] == fv[m][0]): continue
        rho = spearmanr(fv[m], rv[m]).correlation
        out.append(rho if np.isfinite(rho) else np.nan)
    return np.array(out)

def stats(ic):
    ok = np.isfinite(ic)
    if ok.sum() < 20: return dict(n=int(ok.sum()), ic=np.nan, icir=np.nan)
    ic = ic[ok]
    return dict(n=int(ok.sum()), ic=float(np.nanmean(ic)), icir=float(np.nanmean(ic) / np.nanstd(ic)))

fids = ["rev_1d","rev_2d","rev_3d","rev_5d","nclv_1d","nclv_2d","nclv_3d","nclv_5d",
        "nbody_1d","id_rev_1d","rev_1d_vs","mom_120d_skip5","vol_of_vol20x60","vix_beta_cond_60x20"]

print("=== IC by horizon: since-2026-08 window (post-warmup live period) ===")
print(f"{'factor':<20}{'ic1':>8}{'ic5':>8}{'ic10':>8}{'ic1_icir':>10}{'ic5_icir':>10}{'ic10_icir':>11}")
rows = {}
for fid in fids:
    fdf = build(fid)
    if fdf is None: continue
    w = fdf.loc["2026-08-01":]
    s1, s5, s10 = stats(daily_ic(w,1)), stats(daily_ic(w,5)), stats(daily_ic(w,10))
    rows[fid] = (s1, s5, s10)
    print(f"{fid:<20}{s1['ic']:>+8.4f}{s5['ic']:>+8.4f}{s10['ic']:>+8.4f}{s1['icir']:>+10.3f}{s5['icir']:>+10.3f}{s10['icir']:>+11.3f}")

print("\n=== IC by horizon: recent 250 trading days ===")
print(f"{'factor':<20}{'ic1':>8}{'ic5':>8}{'ic10':>8}{'ic1_icir':>10}{'ic5_icir':>10}{'ic10_icir':>11}")
rows250 = {}
for fid in fids:
    fdf = build(fid)
    if fdf is None: continue
    w = fdf.iloc[-250:]
    s1, s5, s10 = stats(daily_ic(w,1)), stats(daily_ic(w,5)), stats(daily_ic(w,10))
    rows250[fid] = (s1, s5, s10)
    print(f"{fid:<20}{s1['ic']:>+8.4f}{s5['ic']:>+8.4f}{s10['ic']:>+8.4f}{s1['icir']:>+10.3f}{s5['icir']:>+10.3f}{s10['icir']:>+11.3f}")

print("\n=== Quality q = |IC10|*|ICIR10| on since-2026-08 window (with sign) ===")
q = {}
for fid in fids:
    if fid in rows:
        s10 = rows[fid][2]
        q[fid] = (np.sign(s10['ic']) if np.isfinite(s10['ic']) else 0.0) * abs(s10['ic']) * abs(s10['icir'])
for fid in sorted(q, key=lambda k: -abs(q[k])):
    print(f"{fid:<20}{q[fid]:>+10.4f}")

# Factor correlation (average pairwise across recent window)
print("\n=== Factor signal correlation (recent 250d, daily cross-section mean) ===")
sig = {}
for fid in fids:
    fdf = build(fid)
    if fdf is None: continue
    w = fdf.iloc[-250:]
    sig[fid] = w.mean(axis=1)
S = pd.DataFrame(sig)
corr = S.corr()
fids_sorted = sorted(fids)
for i, a in enumerate(fids_sorted):
    line = []
    for b in fids_sorted:
        v = corr.loc[a, b]
        line.append(f"{v:+.2f}" if np.isfinite(v) else "  NA")
    print(f"{a:<20}" + " ".join(line))

# Regime assessment
print("\n=== Regime assessment (through 2027-03-18) ===")
for a in WATCH:
    c = C[a].dropna()
    if len(c) < 250: continue
    r = c.pct_change().dropna()
    ma50 = c.rolling(50).mean().iloc[-1]
    ma200 = c.rolling(200).mean().iloc[-1]
    last = c.iloc[-1]
    ret20 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-21] - 1
    ret60 = c.iloc[-1]/c.iloc[-61] - 1
    vol20 = r.iloc[-20:].std()*np.sqrt(252)
    dd = (c/c.cummax()-1).iloc[-1]
    print(f"{a:<12} close={last:>10.2f} ma50={ma50:>10.2f} ma200={ma200:>10.2f} "
          f"r20={ret20:>+7.1%} r60={ret60:>+7.1%} vol20={vol20:>6.1%} dd={dd:>7.1%}")

# Cross-asset correlation regime
rc = R.iloc[-60:]
cc = rc.corr()
vals = cc.values[np.triu_indices(len(cc), 1)]
print(f"\nAvg pairwise corr (60d, 15 assets): {np.nanmean(vals):.3f}")
rc250 = R.iloc[-250:]
cc250 = rc250.corr()
vals250 = cc250.values[np.triu_indices(len(cc250), 1)]
print(f"Avg pairwise corr (250d, 15 assets): {np.nanmean(vals250):.3f}")

# VIX level
vix_last = VIX.iloc[-1]
print(f"VIX last={vix_last:.1f} 20d ago={VIX.iloc[-21]:.1f} chg20={(vix_last/VIX.iloc[-21]-1):+.1%}")

python -c "
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob
files = sorted(glob.glob('../persistent/stock_data/*.csv'))
px = {}
for f in files:
    name = f.split('/')[-1].replace('.csv','')
    df = pd.read_csv(f)
    df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
    dc = 'date' if 'date' in df.columns else df.columns[0]
    df[dc] = pd.to_datetime(df[dc])
    df = df[df[dc] <= '2027-04-01'].set_index(dc).sort_index()
    px[name] = df['close'].astype(float)
P = pd.DataFrame(px)
R = P.pct_change()
print('=== SPX trend ===')
for w in [20,60,120]:
    ma = P['SPX'].rolling(w).mean()
    slope = (ma.iloc[-1]/ma.iloc[-1-10]-1)*100
    print(f'MA{w}: {ma.iloc[-1]:.0f} 10d slope {slope:+.2f}%  price/MA {P[\"SPX\"].iloc[-1]/ma.iloc[-1]-1:+.3f}')
print()
print('=== regime stats ===')
print('VIX last:', 24.08, '| 20d VIX mean:', )
vix = pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv'); vix.columns=[c.strip() for c in vix.columns]
vix['date']=pd.to_datetime(vix['date']); vix=vix[vix['date']<='2027-04-01'].set_index('date')['close'].astype(float)
print('VIX 20d avg:', round(vix.tail(20).mean(),1), '| VIX 63d avg:', round(vix.tail(63).mean(),1), '| VIX 252d avg:', round(vix.tail(252).mean(),1))
print('VIX 20d change:', round((vix.iloc[-1]/vix.iloc[-21]-1)*100,1),'%')
print()
# cross-sectional dispersion: std of 21d returns across assets
disp = R.tail(21).mean().std()*100
print('cross-sectional dispersion (21d mean ret std):', round(disp,2),'%')
# avg pairwise correlation of 21d returns
c = R.tail(63).corr()
vals = c.values[np.triu_indices_from(c.values,1)]
print('avg pairwise corr (63d):', round(np.nanmean(vals),3), '| median:', round(np.nanmedian(vals),3))
# breadth
up = (R.tail(21)>0).sum(axis=1)
print('21d avg daily breadth (up count/15):', round(up.mean(),2))
# trend strength: days above 50d MA
above = (P > P.rolling(50).mean()).iloc[-1].sum()
print('assets above 50d MA:', above, '/15')
# 60d ann vol average
print('avg ann vol (63d):', round((R.tail(63).std()*np.sqrt(252)).mean()*100,1),'%')
"

files={}

    s=os.path.basename(p)[:-4]
    df=pd.read_csv(p, parse_dates=[0])
    df['date']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    files[s]=df[df['date']<='2027-04-15'].set_index('date')['close'].sort_index()
px=pd.DataFrame(files)
last=px.iloc[-1]
ma20=px.iloc[-20:].mean()
ma60=px.iloc[-60:].mean()
ma120=px.iloc[-120:].mean()
ret=px.pct_change()
print('=== trend map (close vs MAs) ===')
for s in ['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']:
    c=last[s]; m20=ma20[s]; m60=ma60[s]; m120=ma120[s]
    d20=(c/m20-1)*100; d60=(c/m60-1)*100; d120=(c/m120-1)*100
    trend='UP' if (c>m60 and m60>ma120[s]) else ('DOWN' if (c<m60 and m60<ma120[s]) else 'MIX')
    print('%-10s c=%9.2f d20=%6.1f%% d60=%6.1f%% d120=%6.1f%%  %s' % (s,c,d20,d60,d120,trend))
print()
print('=== 60d vol & skew of cross-sectional dispersion (avg |rank ret - mean|) ===')
print()
print('=== 6M performance (120d) ===')
w6=ret.tail(120)
print((1+w6).prod().sub(1).mul(100).round(1).sort_values(ascending=False))
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, glob, os

assets = ['000300.SH','000688.SH','BTC','CN10Y','COPPER','ETH','HSI','N225','NDX','SOX','SPX','SX5E','US10Y','WTI','XAU']
data = {}
for a in assets:
    df = pd.read_csv(f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv')
    df.columns = [c.strip().lower() for c in df.columns]
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
    df = df.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date')
    df['ret'] = df['close'].pct_change()
    data[a] = df.set_index('date')['close']

px = pd.DataFrame(data).sort_index()
ret = px.pct_change()
print("px tail date:", px.index[-1].date(), "rows:", len(px))

# last date in dataset
last = px.index[-1]
for lookback,label in [(5,'5d'),(20,'1m'),(60,'3m'),(120,'6m'),(250,'1y')]:
    if len(px) > lookback:
        r = px.iloc[-1]/px.iloc[-1-lookback]-1
        print(f"\n{label} return:")
        for a in assets:
            print(f"  {a:10s} {r[a]*100:8.2f}%")

# 22d realized vol annualized
rv = ret.tail(22).std()*np.sqrt(252)
print("\n22d realized vol (ann. %):")
for a in assets:
    print(f"  {a:10s} {rv[a]*100:7.1f}%")

# cross-sectional dispersion of 20d returns
disp20 = ret.tail(20).sum().std()
print(f"\nCS dispersion 20d ret std: {disp20*100:.2f}%")

# avg pairwise corr last 60d
c = ret.tail(60).corr()
vals = c.values[np.triu_indices_from(c.values, k=1)]
print(f"avg pairwise corr 60d: {np.nanmean(vals):.2f}")
c20 = ret.tail(20).corr()
vals20 = c20.values[np.triu_indices_from(c20.values, k=1)]
print(f"avg pairwise corr 20d: {np.nanmean(vals20):.2f}")
